# Licence texts not shipped in the Nerd Fonts FontPatcher archive

These texts are copied verbatim from the upstream projects so that they can be
redistributed together with the font (`scripts/build.sh` puts them in
`dist/licenses/third-party/`).  They were retrieved from the upstream default
branch, not from the exact release that Nerd Fonts bundles; only the licence
text is relied on, not any other file.

| File | Applies to | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Apache-2.0.txt` | Material Design Icons (Pictogrammers). The archive only ships a short summary that points to this text, and Apache-2.0 §4(a) requires a copy of the licence. | https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.txt |
| `Devicon-MIT.txt` | Devicons (konpa) | https://github.com/devicons/devicon/blob/master/LICENSE |
| `Seti-UI-MIT.txt` | Seti-UI (Jesse Weed), basis of Nerd Fonts' "Original Source" icons | https://github.com/jesseweed/seti-ui/blob/master/LICENSE.md |
| `Font-Logos-Unlicense.txt` | Font Logos (Lukas W), public domain dedication | https://github.com/Lukas-W/font-logos/blob/master/LICENSE |

Font Awesome Extension and the IEC Power Symbols carry no licence file anywhere
we could reach; both are listed as MIT in the Nerd Fonts licence audit
(<https://github.com/ryanoasis/nerd-fonts/blob/master/license-audit.md>), which is
the only source used for them.  See `NOTICE.md`.
